label: caiso 174 control flatfleet
definition: caiso-174 Arm A CONTROL: the caiso-172 keeper recipe replayed at post-epoch main with storage_measured_base_fleet=FALSE. NOT a reconstruction of the pre-epoch keeper -- FFR-4D ALSO re-vintaged the constant STORAGE_BASE_FLEET_MW['CAISO'] 8,000 -> 15,450 MW (mid), which no flag gates, so this arm runs a FLAT 15,450 MW battery fleet in every year. It is the 'what if only the constant had been re-vintaged' counterfactual, and it isolates incidental code drift between the keeper's head 789e28b8 and this one so the Arm B delta is attributable to the per-year vintaging leg alone. See PRECHECK-caiso174 4a.
